name: bitwarden-docs
description: Search official Bitwarden help and selected sales references on this computer, with cited guidance and optional highlighted screenshots.
long_description: Public documentation only. Search and read cited sections with verified section links and excerpt hashes, get cited admin and security guidance, optionally capture highlighted screenshots of official pages with your installed Chrome or Edge, inspect freshness, and refresh the local cache. No Bitwarden login, vault access, hosting, or API key. First use downloads official English documentation. Text and screenshots returned by the tools are sent to Claude for its answer. This extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bitwarden. Private extension updates require installing a new package.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find relevant official documentation passages with source URLs and section links.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a document or section with pagination, excerpt hashes and citations.

tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Get cited admin and security guidance with missing-information prompts.

tools.name: capture_evidence
tools.description: Capture a highlighted screenshot of an official passage using an installed browser.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Browse the full cached documentation catalogue.

tools.name: docs_status
tools.description: Check coverage, freshness, section links and refresh failures.

tools.name: refresh_docs
tools.description: Download current official documentation into the local cache.
